create.name: Tim Walter
create.bio:
Tim Walter is a dowser, house healer and alternative life coach based in the Yorkshire Dales in the north of England. He spent around thirty years writing, directing and producing film, television and conference work, mostly corporate messaging, before his attention turned to subtle energy. In 1998 he and his family moved into a Georgian townhouse that, as he tells it, they shared with a resident spirit, and this set him on the path of earth energy and dowsing. He went on to study with the dowser Hamish Miller and learned the house healing method of Adrian Incledon-Webber.

He works remotely with homes and workplaces through intuitive dowsing, spiritual healing and coaching, and he mentors and trains others; since 2020 he has taught close to a hundred people his approach to house healing through group courses on Zoom, and he founded an online community for them. His YouTube channel, KnightsRose, carries beginners' lessons in dowsing with rods and pendulum, talks on ley lines and earth energy, archive footage of Hamish Miller and interviews. He co-wrote Spirit & Earth with Adrian Incledon-Webber, and his own book What Now? (2026) presents dowsing as a simple spiritual path.

books.title: What Now?: Exploring a Simple Spiritual Path Through Dowsing and Self-Discovery
books.author: Tim Walter
books.description: A practical introduction to dowsing as a way of spiritual enquiry and self-discovery, using a pendulum, rods and intuition. Each chapter ends with an exercise, alongside a look at ideas about a conscious, interconnected universe.

books.title: Spirit & Earth: a handbook for modern holistic living
books.author: Adrian Incledon-Webber, Tim Walter
books.description: A handbook co-written with the dowser Adrian Incledon-Webber on earth energy, dowsing and the spirit of place in the home. It sets out the house healing approach the two authors work with.

courses.title: Mentoring with Tim Walter
courses.description: One-to-one mentoring sessions by video call for people who want to strengthen their intuitive connection, work towards specific goals or learn his house healing method. Based on the protocol he learned from Adrian Incledon-Webber and the teaching of Hamish Miller.
